title: The Zombie Who Was Afraid of a Human
premise: A mischievous zombie sneaks behind a deadpan midnight convenience-store shopper, catches one glance in the shopper's pocket vanity mirror, panics at his own reflection, trips past a traffic cone, and hides behind the 24H sidewalk sign.
hook: Why did this zombie scream louder than his victim?
narration: He crept up behind a midnight shopper, caught one glimpse in the mirror, screamed faster than any human, and hid behind the open sign!

beats.action: Mischievous zombie peeks out from alley neon glow preparing a scare
Zombie tiptoes across wet puddle behind deadpan late-night shopper
Shopper casually tilts pocket mirror reflecting zombie's own face
Zombie freezes with popped eyes in shock then bursts into scream
Zombie scrambles backward in high-knee articulated dash across wet curb
Scrambling legs kick orange traffic cone spinning into puddle
Unbothered shopper blinks calmly and checks pocket mirror
Zombie shivers hiding behind glowing A-frame sign on the corner
